# plotly

## Purpose
plotly.js 2.35.2, gl3d partial bundle (3D traces only), MIT licence (see `LICENSE`).

## Contents
- `plotly-gl3d.min.js`: the library, exposing the global `Plotly` (about 1.7 MB).
- `LICENSE`: MIT licence text.

## Inputs/Outputs
- Inputs: release file of the npm package `plotly.js-gl3d-dist-min@2.35.2`.
- Outputs: the `Plotly` object used by the 3D convergence view.

## Depends on
- Nothing else.

## Used by
- `js/convergence-3d.js`.
